title: Liran Tal - Your AI Agent Installed Malware Because a SKILL.md Told It To - AI DevCon June 2026
description:
That SKILL.md file you downloaded to enhance your AI coding agent might actually be a cybersecurity risk. According to the recent ToxicSkills research, 37% of nearly 4,000 examined skills contained malware or security vulnerabilities. One example includes a 'security scanner' that was secretly harboring malware. It sounds safe. It's not.

Liran Tal, a senior developer advocate at Snyk, shares his expertise on the vulnerabilities within Agent Skill ecosystems. With a rich background in secure coding and significant experience in Node and JavaScript, Liran provides insight into the threats posed by malicious skills. He demonstrates how attackers exploit these skills and how developers can better secure their agents against such risks.

What we cover:
• Live hacking of a malicious skill and how it deceives coding agents
• Prompt injection that leaks secrets over email
• What happens when a skill passes credit card numbers through the LLM context
• Detection techniques for malware in skills.md files
• How to develop a threat model for Agent Skills supply chains
